EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A cluster of thunderstorms moved northward into Connecticut during the morning ahead of a short-wave trough southwest of southern New England.  The showers and thunderstorms spread northeastward into the early afternoon.  One storm produced a lightning strike that started a house fire in northeast Massachusetts. Several roads were flooded in Worcester County.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: In Holden, Main St and several side streets were flooded in spots up to one ft.
